title.zh: ⚡️美国9月PPI年率录得6.3%，高于市场预期
title.en: ⚡️美国9月PPI年率录得6.3%，高于市场预期

current_state.zh: 美国9月PPI数据全面超预期：整体PPI环比1.3%、同比6.3%，核心PPI环比0.7%、同比5.0%，能源成本传导及顽固通胀压力强化美联储加息预期。
current_state.en: US September PPI data exceeded expectations across the board: headline PPI +1.3% MoM and +6.3% YoY, core PPI +0.7% MoM and +5.0% YoY, with energy cost pass-through and persistent inflation reinforcing Fed tightening expectations.

updates.title_zh: ⚡️美国9月PPI年率录得6.3%，高于市场预期
updates.title_en: ⚡️美国9月PPI年率录得6.3%，高于市场预期
updates.what_changed_zh: 美国9月PPI同比上涨6.3%，环比上涨1.3%，均远高于市场预期，并创下2026年5月以来最高年度读数，零售销售也超出预期。
updates.what_changed_en: US September PPI rose 6.3% year-over-year and 1.3% month-over-month, both well above market expectations and the highest annual reading since May 2026, with retail sales also beating forecasts.

updates.current_state_en: US September PPI rose 6.3% year-over-year and 1.3% month-over-month, both well above market expectations and the highest annual reading since May 2026, with retail sales also beating forecasts.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: US September PPI rose 6.3% year-over-year and 1.3% month-over-month, both well above market expectations and the highest annual reading since May 2026, with retail sales also beating forecasts.
updates.detailed_summary_en: US September PPI rose 6.3% year-over-year and 1.3% month-over-month, both well above market expectations and the highest annual reading since May 2026, with retail sales also beating forecasts.

updates.title_zh: ⚡️通胀压力持续升温，美国9月PPI数据大幅走高
updates.title_en: ⚡️通胀压力持续升温，美国9月PPI数据大幅走高
updates.what_changed_zh: 核心PPI环比上涨0.7%，同比上涨5.0%，能源成本上涨的影响传导至经济各领域，未来六个月投入价格预期指标升至2022年以来最高，强化了美联储继续加息的预期。
updates.what_changed_en: Core PPI rose 0.7% MoM and 5.0% YoY, with energy costs feeding through the economy; the six-month input price expectations gauge rose to its highest since 2022, reinforcing expectations of further Fed tightening.
updates.current_state_zh: 美国9月PPI数据全面超预期：整体PPI环比1.3%、同比6.3%，核心PPI环比0.7%、同比5.0%，能源成本传导及顽固通胀压力强化美联储加息预期。
updates.current_state_en: US September PPI data exceeded expectations across the board: headline PPI +1.3% MoM and +6.3% YoY, core PPI +0.7% MoM and +5.0% YoY, with energy cost pass-through and persistent inflation reinforcing Fed tightening expectations.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: US September producer prices rose far more than expected — headline PPI up 1.3% month-over-month and 6.3% year-over-year, core up 0.7% and 5.0% — as energy costs fed through the economy, reinforcing expectations that the Fed will keep tightening.
updates.detailed_summary_en: US September producer prices rose far more than expected — headline PPI up 1.3% month-over-month and 6.3% year-over-year, core up 0.7% and 5.0% — as energy costs fed through the economy, reinforcing expectations that the Fed will keep tightening.
